verdict: Meta leads surging; Google spend needs rebalancing before next week.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 33 leads at an average cost per lead of $129.96 — and every one of those leads came through Meta, which delivered them at $44.42 each. Google Ads ran $2,822.81 in spend over the same window and produced 2 conversions, a cost-per-lead that is not sustainable at that ratio. We are actively rebalancing budget toward Meta and tightening Google's targeting to bring its efficiency in line. Separately, 115 opportunities are sitting in your pipeline with no appointments booked and none marked won, which points to a gap in the intake process rather than an ads problem — we are working with your team to address that now. Next week you should see continued lead flow from Meta and a leaner Google footprint while intake is tightened.
